data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Godcrofts Changes Hands Amid Flare-Ups on Northern Fronts
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the midday edition Godcrofts has reversed to nine Colonial holdings with seventy-two changes on the day, twenty in the last two hours to 14:43 about The Axehead, Fleecewatch and Isawa. Stlican Shelf runs to the wire with twenty-eight changes on the day, three in the last two hours to the cutoff about Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn, now standing five Warden to four Colonial. Farranac Coast has newly stirred with five changes in two hours to 14:56 about The Bone Haft and Transient Valley, holding one Warden to nine Colonial with one base neutral. Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Mooring County, Fisherman's Row and Stonecradle report no change in the last two hours, though Weathered Expanse counts twenty-nine changes on the day to 12:36 about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk for six Colonial to three Warden, Fisherman's Row thirty-nine to 13:15 about Arcadia and Eidolo for nine Colonial, Stonecradle twenty-eight to 07:56 about The Heir's Knife and Trammel Pool for five Warden to four Colonial, and Linn Mercy seventeen to 12:36 now eleven Colonial. Callahan's Passage stays quiet on the wires despite more than ten thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden losses on the day.
